title: 巴克莱邵炯：AI云增长45%，三年回本为何不激进？
speaker: Jiong Shao

segments.en: The results were very strong in all opinion. But what's even more amazing is the outlook.
segments.zh: 我们认为业绩非常强劲，但更令人惊叹的是前景展望。

segments.en: And as your reporter just talked about, the key focus is really on the AI cloud and it grew 45% over the years. That's a nine consecutive quarter of a set of rating growth.
segments.zh: 正如记者提到的，焦点在AI云业务，同比增长45%，已连续九个季度加速增长。

segments.en: And the outlook suggests that that growth could be 50%. Or higher in September quarter and still higher in the December or March quarter.
segments.zh: 展望显示，9月当季增速可能达到50%或更高，12月或3月当季还会更高。

segments.en: So this is the very, very encouraging and set of data points pointing to the strength in the AI cloud business.
segments.zh: 这些数据点非常令人鼓舞，凸显了AI云业务的强劲势头。

segments.en: We actually don't think that's ambitious at all. That's pretty much in line with what other hypersteaders in the U.S. and some of the new cloud players in the States are saying.
segments.zh: 我们并不认为这激进，这与美国其他超大规模云服务商的说法基本一致。

segments.en: A three-year payback time is incredibly good in all opinion.
segments.zh: 三年回本周期我们认为非常理想。

segments.en: If I spend the money to buy a apartment in Hong Kong and rent it out, if I can get my money back in three years, it will be created for me not to do it.
segments.zh: 如果我在香港买房出租，三年能回本，那我不做才怪。

segments.en: So we think investors should not be really, really concerned about the Adivabas CapEx currently because they need to invest to grow and accelerate their growth in the coming years in their AI business.
segments.zh: 我们认为市场不必过度担忧当前的资本开支，因为这是为了未来几年AI业务的增长和加速。

segments.en: And the return is so fast, right? It's really going to have three years. That's an incredibly short amount of time to get your money back.
segments.zh: 回报如此之快，三年回本，这是非常短的时间。

segments.en: And this is necessary and very much needed for Adivabas cloud business because they are the only really hyper-scatter that's providing CSP, that's cloud service provider, to the rest of the tech companies and to all enterprises in China for the AI compute needs.
segments.zh: 这对阿里云业务非常必要，因为他们是唯一真正为其他科技公司和国内企业提供AI算力云服务的超大规模厂商。
